subject: Request: Executive approval for 26% Hosted API usage discount — GuardianAI
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@guardianai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing ask for Hosted API pilot

Hi Jordan / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looks promising for our ingestion pipeline. Our procurement team ran the pilot numbers and the projected monthly token usage sits around 1.9B tokens for Q1 if we move to production.

We can commit to a 12-month minimum if we can secure more aggressive unit economics. Specifically, we were hoping Redwood could consider a 26% off list rate for Hosted API usage for the 12-month term. That level pushes us over the threshold for internal approval here.

Attached: GuardianAI_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes token projection and monthly ramp.

Can you advise whether that discount is possible and if you need anything formal from us (PO, signed SOW, references)?

Best,
Elena
Elena Morris
VP Product, GuardianAI
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@guardianai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing ask for Hosted API pilot

Elena —

Appreciate the clarity and the forecast. Short answer: 26% is outside standard delegated discounts for Hosted API; I’ll need to escalate to get executive signoff because it exceeds 20%.

Next steps I recommend:
- I’ll open an internal request and include your forecast + 12-month commitment language.
- If you can share a draft SOW (even high level) it will help finance model the margin hit.
- If GuardianAI can confirm the 12-month minimum and a quarterly usage review cadence, that will increase the chance of approval.

I copied Ben to coordinate attachments and Marcus for finance impact once we have a formal ask. Expect an internal escalation email from me by end of day tomorrow.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@guardianai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena@guardianai.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing ask for Hosted API pilot

Jordan —

Thanks. To be explicit: GuardianAI needs confirmation of 26% off list for Hosted API tokens on the proposed 12-month minimum to proceed to legal & procurement. We can sign a PO for the first quarter immediately once pricing is agreed and we can accept quarterly reconciliation.

Also attaching the SOW draft we circulated internally — the production ramp schedule is on tab "Ramp".

Regards,
Samir
Co-Founder, GuardianAI
Attachment: SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: ESCALATION: GuardianAI requests 26% Hosted API usage discount (deal DF-2029-1743)

Team —

Need a quick exec decision. External ask summarized below:
- Account: GuardianAI (prospect moving to production)
- Ask: 26% off Hosted API per-token pricing (one tariff for both text gen + embeddings)
- Commitment: 12-month minimum; projected first-month usage ~1.9B tokens, steady-state ~2.2B by month 3 (see attached forecast)
- Deal mechanics: PO for Q1, SOW with quarterly reconciliation; customer requests invoice-level usage breakout and token-level audit logs (standard)
- Risk/impact: at 26% above delegated thresholds — quick model shows ~25% gross margin compression on token line in Y1 if we accept as-is (Marcus can confirm).

Attachments (from customer): GuardianAI_usage_forecast.xlsx, SOW_draft.pdf

Recommended options for approval:
A) Provisional exec approval for 26% for 12 months conditioned on:
   - 12-month minimum commitment (non-cancellable)
   - Quarterly usage reconciliation and a milestone-clause limiting liability for sudden spike
   - Finance to confirm net margin floor or propose counter-offer (Marcus)
B) Offer a tiered approach: 20% up front, moving to 26% after 3 consecutive months above 1.8B tokens (reduces immediate margin hit)

Asking Stephanie for sign-off or guidance; tagging Marcus for finance impact and Ben to stay aligned on timeline. This is a strategic target account; GuardianAI is prioritizing Redwood for low-latency inference.

Thanks —
Jordan
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ESCALATION: GuardianAI requests 26% Hosted API usage discount (deal DF-2029-1743)

Jordan / Ben / Marcus —

Thank you for the summary. After reviewing the forecast and partner fit, I approve a one-year commercial concession at 26% off list for Hosted API usage under the following conditions:
1) GuardianAI signs a 12-month minimum commitment (non-cancellable) and provides a PO for Q1 within five business days of contract signature.
2) Include a tiered ramp clause: the 26% applies only after monthly usage >= 1.8B tokens for two consecutive months; otherwise pricing reverts to 20% until threshold met. This mitigates rapid-step risk.
3) Finance (Marcus) to confirm net margin floor; if margin falls below the agreed floor, we reserve the right to renegotiate incremental months.
4) Legal to add standard audit rights and a quarterly SLA review.

Ben — please draft the concession memo and update the SOW link to reflect the ramp clause; Marcus, please run the final margin scenario and confirm. Jordan, communicate the conditional approval to GuardianAI and request the PO + signature window.

Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Global Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: approval-summary.txt (text summary)
